question: Which of the following statements is true about the invertibility of a function $f: A \to B$?
explanation:
A function is invertible if and only if it is bijective (i.e., one-one and onto).

(A) $f$ is invertible only if it is one-one and onto

options.A: $f$ is invertible only if it is one-one and onto
options.B: $f$ is invertible if it is only one-one
options.C: $f$ is invertible if it is only onto
